root_cause.text: The af_alg_alloc_tsgl() function fails to remove the SG end-of-list marker from the last entry of the previous scatter-gather list before chaining a new list, causing sg_next() to terminate early and leading to a NULL pointer dereference in the crypto scatterwalk.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "fails to clear the end marker on the previous SGL's last data entry" and the patch adds `sg_unmark_end(sg + MAX_SGL_ENTS - 1);` before `sg_chain()`, confirming that the missing unmark was the root cause.

intent_record.how: The change ensures that the last scatterlist entry (sg + MAX_SGL_ENTS - 1) has its end-of-list marker cleared before chaining, preventing incorrect termination during scatterlist processing.

candidates.rationale: This statement chains a new scatterlist onto the previous list's last entry without first clearing the SG end-of-list marker on that entry.
